item.title: Emma Thomas Breaks The Box For 'The Odyssey,' Teases Nolan Is "Mulling" Next Movie & What Changed Her Mind About Producing Solo [Interview]
item.description: She's an Oscar winner, a PGA Award winner, and a BAFTA Award winner, but it often feels as though Emma Thomas doesn't get the kudos she deserves. As Christopher Nolan 's longtime producing partner, she has shepherded all 13 of his directorial efforts from the indie-budgeted thrillers "Following" and "Memento" to a genre-defying "Dark Knight" trilogy to 19th-century London with "The Prestige" to a WWII epic in "Dunkirk" to the far reaches of space with "Interstellar," and a Best Picture win with "Oppenheimer" and a $2 billion global grosser this past summer with "The Odyssey." But she only has one film on her resume that Nolan didn't direct, Zack Snyder's "Man of Steel." She has a few executive producer credits on the side, but for the most part, hasn't taken the reins of a project with a different filmmaker. Continue reading Emma Thomas Breaks The Box For 'The Odyssey,' Teases Nolan Is "Mulling" Next Movie & What Changed Her Mind About Producing Solo [Interview] at The Playlist.
